_candidate.status: release-path check spec for Milestone 3 finalist F1 (M3-A-soup); verified on node B GPU6 without --upload / --collect. Before a real release: write the coordinator's decision (draft or final) under /data/dev2/runs/release/decisions/ and point gate_receipt at it, review card.text (confirmation line, training, limits) and rerun release.sh into a new work dir with --upload (and --collect only with a final decision).
_candidate.own_1_0_slot: The ~27B tier has no Decision 1.0 model. card.py needs exactly one 'own-1.0' entry and uses only its label and report (summary, tradeoffs table, EVALUATION paired line), so AutoJev-27B, the tier's release-gate reference (M3 prereg), fills that slot; card.paired is the paired comparison against it. gate.py item 1_beats_own_1_0 (paired low > 0) will fail for this candidate (v3 -4.92 [-6.82, -0.43] vs AutoJev-27B), so 'gate seal' / --collect needs a coordinator decision on the ~27B gate item first.
_candidate.card_example_base: the card's Python example loads the adapter package without base_path, so the runtime calls snapshot_download(Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B@1d4bf0f2) for the pinned base files; the offline verification container gets them from an HF-cache-shaped directory (HF_HUB_CACHE) whose snapshot links to base.path.

frozen_autotune_cache.origin: fresh copy of /data/dev2/runs/27b/m3-warm-32768/triton-cache (tree 583241fbc3bc89e22be51a49722996eab742162356100400d64fb4208cb20daf) plus the formal run's additions (2,659 files, 18 autotune entries); release runs copy it with python3 -m v2.27b.triton_cache copy --expect <tree_sha256>

origin.summary: A PEFT LoRA adapter (rank 16, alpha 32, on all 496 text projections of the attention, gated-delta and MLP blocks) and a native candidate head trained on the frozen Qwen3.8-27B text backbone at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0` (Apache-2.0), which is not redistributed. The adapter is the exact uniform soup of two seeds of one rank-8 recipe (their LoRA factors stacked along the rank with the up-projections halved, so the mean of the two seeds' weight updates is reproduced exactly), with the two heads averaged.

runtime_equivalence: decision2/qwen.py loads the unmerged PEFT adapter on the pinned Qwen3.8-27B base (every base file checked against its SHA-256) with the vendored training/model sources whose SHA-256 equal the scored adapter sources (checked at build time), and applies the per-item batching, BF16-backbone / FP32-head execution, raw probabilities (temperature 1; no calibration file) and answer normalization of training.model.infer as run by v2.27b.typed_collect_kernel. Checked on one GPU of the scoring node against the scored T = 1 predictions of every formal prompt (typed-final 1,600, css15 6,547, public231 231) by release.sh --parity, with the image's FLA and causal-conv1d kernels required and a fresh copy of the formal run's persisted Triton autotune cache.

components.component: DEV2.0-27B LoRA adapter, decision head, package runtime, card and artwork
Qwen3.8-27B text backbone and tokenizer (pinned external base, not redistributed)

attributions: [Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0`: frozen text backbone and tokenizer of this adapter, not redistributed (Apache-2.0, `LICENSES/Qwen3.8-27B-LICENSE.txt`).

Training data of this adapter (not redistributed here; each keeps its own licence): the strict Decision 2.0 base mixture (project-generated verifiable rules, counterfactuals, hard negatives and multi-level Score tasks plus the human labels of public reading, commonsense, dialogue, topic, emotion, inference and graded-similarity datasets), the A6 generated typed-reasoning arms, and the Decision 2.0 A7 typed curricula (program-generated Stage 1-4 decision tasks labeled by program oracles, and the human intent labels of BANKING77 (Casanueva et al., 2020; CC BY 4.0) and CLINC150 (Larson et al., EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019; CC BY 3.0)).
Evaluation data shown on the card: JevArena v3 and JevBench public 231 (panels described in `evaluation/EVALUATION.md`).

Owl banner: a new owl with a ringed planet for the 27B tier, generated in the Decision 1.0 mosaic style, in the DEV2.0 name layout; wordmark set in Poppins (SIL Open Font License) and DejaVu Sans Bold.

card.calibration_text: raw model probabilities (temperature 1). Per-type temperatures fitted on the clean 698-item calibration partition (Choice 0.538, Noul 0.428, Score 0.567) were evaluated and not adopted because they worsened calibration on out-of-distribution development data.
card.requirements_text: Tested on one ROCm GPU with Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.12, Transformers 5.17 and PEFT 0.21 (BF16 backbone, FP32 head; about 104 GB of GPU memory at the 32,768-token limit). The runtime downloads the pinned Qwen3.8-27B base files (or takes `base_path`) and checks every file's SHA-256 before loading. GPU answers match the evaluated predictions with the flash-linear-attention 0.5.2 and causal-conv1d 1.7.0 kernels and a persisted Triton autotune cache; without those kernels Transformers uses its reference implementation of the same operations, which is slower and differs slightly in the last digits.

text.tagline: A decision model for routing choices, yes/no checks and rubric scores over one state: native System One Choice, Noul and Score answers with probabilities, no chat API.
text.architecture: A rank-16 LoRA adapter on the frozen 64-layer Qwen3.8-27B text backbone (48 gated-delta and 16 attention layers) reads the state, the question and every supplied candidate once; a shared candidate head scores the candidates against a global query and returns probabilities without generating text.
text.runtime_note: The download includes a small local runtime (`decision2/`) for one CUDA or ROCm GPU; it fetches the pinned base and does not start a hosted endpoint.
text.confirmation: **Independent sealed confirmation (JevArena-C1): PLACEHOLDER — to be added after the final sealed scoring event.**
text.comparator_note: The ~27B tier has no Decision 1.0 model, so the summary and tradeoffs compare with AutoJev-27B, the strongest same-size model shown.
training: **Recipe:** a rank-8 LoRA (alpha 16, dropout 0.05) on all 496 text projections of the frozen Qwen3.8-27B base plus a new candidate head, one pass of cross-entropy plus 0.5 × Brier over about 10M tokens of decision rows (inputs up to 4,096 tokens), learning rates LoRA 2e-5 / head 1e-4, seeds 20260926 and 20260928; each seed's checkpoint chosen on a held-out selection set, then the exact uniform soup of the two adapters (one rank-16 adapter whose weight update is the mean of the two) and heads.

**Data:** the strict Decision 2.0 base mixture (two shortcut-prone reading families removed), the A6 generated typed-reasoning arms, and a 5.0M-token slice of the A7 typed curricula with an equal token quota per generated family, including the BANKING77 and CLINC150 intent labels.
**Not used:** outputs of Jev or of any third-party decision model. Datasets keep their own licences ([attributions](ATTRIBUTIONS.md)).
limitations: **Below AutoJev-27B.** JevArena v3 is lower than AutoJev-27B (−4.92, 95% CI [−6.82, −0.43]); typed accuracy is the gap (T 0.788 vs 0.887), while human transfer is level (H 0.574 vs 0.587).
**Calibration.** The package returns raw probabilities (temperature 1); per-type temperatures fitted on the calibration partition were rejected on development data.
**Input limit.** 32,768 tokens for the complete state, question and candidates; longer inputs return an over-budget error instead of being truncated. Training inputs were at most 4,096 tokens.
**Seed soup.** Only the uniform soup of two seeds was evaluated on JevArena v3 and is released; a retrained seed of the same recipe can land below it.
**Base download.** The base weights are not in this repository; loading needs the pinned Qwen3.8-27B revision (about 54 GB) and one GPU with about 104 GB of memory. CPU inference was not verified.
details: **Weights:** the exact soup of two rank-8 LoRA adapters of the same recipe and start (seeds differ only in data order; selected updates 1,614 and 1,414), stored as one standard PEFT rank-16 adapter, plus the averaged decision head.
